_about: letitedit's reference numbers for capabilities.typical, used until this PC has measured 3 finished jobs of a kind and tier. Minutes leave waits out. A key holds one figure, or one per AI it was measured with (`ai`); the nearest to the asked AI is chosen.

short.preview.note: A 25 s Short's log, story and rough cut with its phone proxy, on letitedit's own PC with its models loaded (Claude Opus 5.5 at high effort, from the person's chat setting; 2 files, 55 s of footage). The log stage (16.9 of the 27.2 min) ran while other heavy tests filled the PC, so the minutes may be high; about $4.48 at API prices.

A 30 s Short's log, story and rough cut with its phone proxy, on letitedit's own PC (Claude Opus 5.5 at extra high effort, the person's chat setting, 3 files, about 1.6 min of footage). Provisional: this run's review could not load its models (speech, face checks, voice clean-up, sound tags), so its time and tokens leave those checks out.

short.final.note: A final from a preview (the fine cut 15 min, finish 3 min, the review rounds with their fixes and export 25 min, then the platform files) on letitedit's own PC with its models loaded (the review heard the speech), Claude Opus 5.5 at high effort named in the job; a quiet PC. About $13.38 at API prices; the review's critic session is not counted in the tokens.

A final from a preview (the fine cut, finish, review, export and platform files) on letitedit's own PC, Claude Opus 5.5 at extra high effort, the person's chat setting; a whole New video Short in a learned Look, without a preview, measured 84 min (p90 165) and 44.6M tokens. Provisional: the run's review could not load its models (speech, face checks, voice clean-up, sound tags), so its time and tokens leave those checks out.

still.note: Six headless story_9x16 still jobs, one per layout: photo, photo_dump (two pages), before_after, this_or_that, quote and fact_card. Two small vision turns per job; code handles drawing, colour, privacy and geometry. Median observed wall time includes PC-lock contention (the first three runs did not record lock waits separately). Warm installed font cache; Claude Opus 5.5 at medium. API-equivalent costs $0.065-$0.094 per job. Details and per-layout figures: tests/t284/REPORT.md.

revise.note: A final video revise of a 24.3 s Short with three notes (2 s shorter, captions 20% larger, music 6 dB lower): the AI's changes, two review rounds and two reviewer looks with their fixes, two platform files, SRT, cover and phone proxy, on letitedit's own PC with its models loaded (Claude Opus 5.5 at medium; the critics and looks are counted in the tokens). About $6.79 at API prices. A still's revise is far lighter (two small vision turns, as a still).

retext.note: A caption and overlay fix on a 24.3 s video, two platform files, SRT, cover and phone proxy: 111 s, no AI. One picture chunk bounds the memory of a full-frame caption layer. A separate overlay-only fix reusing the earlier clean master took 52 s, including a 20 MB TikTok target. One sample of each; long videos and drawn scenes are not timed.

conform.note: A 24.3 s real finished video to seven 1080x1920 H.264/30 fps destinations, covers and phone proxy: 244.94 s wall, zero AI tokens. TikTok fits a requested 20 MB cap; audio -14.1 LUFS / -1.9 dBTP. Render-lock waits were not separated from wall time, so this reference can be high. A first run during builds took 849 s; generated 3 s HLG and PQ single-Story checks took 5.76 and 5.63 s. Long videos are not timed. Details: tests/t291/REPORT.md.

index.note: Per hour of new footage, scaled from 0.7 min for 2.2 min of footage (5 files, the speech model loading included); no AI. The vision pass adds about 45 min of graphics card time per hour.
